texts.read_only: The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates. Faint overlapping prints mark the mud around the old milestone, but their number, origin, and direction stay unclear. Cold rain needles Cinderwatch's eastern gate under frayed banners. The approach is jammed with refugees, wagons, and travelers; guards watch with hard, tired discipline. A notice board announces new taxes and curfews, and names a missing patrol. A tavern runner is hawking hot stew and rumor for coin. A ragged stranger hangs back, watching the crowd more than the queue. You commit to bringing the uncertain trail to the watch instead of conducting a private survey. Return to Cinderwatch Gate to give your report. The watch receives your report that the patrol trail becomes unclear at the milestone. The watch has now been warned; no private survey was conducted. You can continue your inquiry at the gate or return to the milestone. You have no established report of further guard activity.
